title: Rule of Thumb: Explaining Artificial Intelligence Systems using Partial Information
abstract: arXiv:2608.10766v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) seeks to explain how an Artificial Intelligence (AI) system arrived at a particular decision. We propose ''Rule of Thumb'' (RoT) explanations, a new approach to XAI based upon a novel formulation that identifies the most relevant features for predicting the behaviour of an AI system, for a particular datapoint. We show how RoT is well-suited to enable XAI in: (a) zero-shot classification using large language models (LLMs), (b) auditing of opaque AI systems without model access, and (c) the use of AI in scientific discovery. Additionally, RoT meets specific requirements from leading AI regulations, provides a familiar interface and visualisations for XAI practitioners, is model-agnostic, and is substantially faster than alternatives.   Code available at: https://github.com/KaiRawal/Rule-of-Thumb-Explaining-Artificial-Intelligence-Systems-using-Partial-Information

translated_title: 经验法则：利用部分信息解释人工智能系统
translated_abstract: 可解释人工智能（XAI）旨在解释人工智能（AI）系统如何得出特定决策。我们提出了一种名为“经验法则”（RoT）的解释方法，这是一种基于新颖公式的XAI新方法，该公式能够识别对于特定数据点预测AI系统行为最相关的特征。我们展示了RoT如何很好地适用于以下场景中的XAI：（a）使用大型语言模型（LLMs）进行零样本分类，（b）在无需模型访问的情况下审计不透明的AI系统，以及（c）AI在科学发现中的应用。此外，RoT满足领先AI法规的特定要求，为XAI从业者提供了熟悉的界面和可视化，具有模型无关性，并且比替代方法快得多。代码可在：https://github.com/KaiRawal/Rule-of-Thumb-Explaining-Artificial-Intelligence-Systems-using-Partial-Information 获取。
tldr: 本文提出了一种名为“经验法则”的新XAI方法，通过识别最相关特征来解释AI决策，适用于零样本分类、无模型访问审计和科学发现，且符合法规要求、模型无关且高效快速。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes "Rule of Thumb" (RoT), a new XAI method that explains AI decisions by identifying the most relevant features, applicable to zero-shot classification, auditing without model access, and scientific discovery, while being regulation-compliant, model-agnostic, and significantly faster.
